name: Kong AI Gateway
short: LLM routing on the Kong API gateway with AI traffic management, PII sanitization, RBAC, analytics, and developer portal; self-hosted OSS core plus managed Konnect and Enterprise tiers.

plans.name: Open Source core
plans.notes: Apache 2.0 self-hosted core; 300+ plugins; no analytics/RBAC/portal included; you run Postgres/Cassandra state and manage upgrades; PII sanitization and RBAC are paid-tier features.

plans.name: Konnect Plus
plans.notes: Serverless $25/mo, Hybrid $200/mo, or Dedicated Cloud $500/mo + $0.15/GB; 1M requests/month included, $200 per additional million, hard cap 10M/month; analytics, RBAC, developer portal; 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Self-hosted license, typically $3k-$15k per node per year (production setups $50k-$200k+/year); advanced RBAC, audit logging, secrets management, FIPS, professional support/SLA; volumes above 10M requests/month.
